I grow cassava on this small plot because it gives us food security even when the maize harvest is poor. I cannot afford to buy fertilizer for this plot — whatever small amount I receive through FISP must go to the maize where it matters most. My children and I will do all the work ourselves: making ridges, planting cuttings, weeding twice during the season, and digging the tubers when they are ready.
